result:
If I could change the world in one way, I’d make empathy effortless — so people could genuinely understand one another’s experiences, fears, and hopes before judging or acting.

Many conflicts, inequalities, and cruelties come from an inability or unwillingness to see the world through someone else’s eyes. If empathy were as natural as breathing, I think societies would make kinder decisions: about poverty, justice, war, the environment, and how we treat each other in everyday life.

It wouldn’t solve every problem instantly, but it would change the foundation on which those problems are addressed.
